# Cleanroom ARM-P: Open Verification Release v1.0.1 — full synopsis

## Overview

A signed and reproducible publication surface for a bounded Python fixture-plane reference implementation covering deterministic evidence export, schema-governed validation, tamper-evident custody, SQLite transaction and recovery controls, and fail-closed state transitions.

The release binds source, schemas, deterministic fixtures, evidence exports, custody records, transaction and recovery controls, human documents, and machine indexes into signed and hashed publication surfaces. It is a bounded reference implementation, not an autonomous AI system or production runtime.

## Verified scope

- 21 mirrored Zenodo/GitHub Release files, 34,029,295 bytes.
- Four coordinated package ZIPs.
- 27 Markdown/PDF pairs and 117 rendered PDF pages.
- Release source commit: fa837780c32e1d5735a281290e4520f3f10b2896.
- Reader/machine commit: 4fc6c29753d039eb0d3ec4decbc1deb258b53751.
- Release publication matrix: 160/160 PASS.
- Post-release publication surface: 108/108 PASS; full suite 197 PASS plus 6 inherited Windows symlink skips.

## Nonclaims

No production readiness, operational Judge, SRLM integration, real L4 capability, matched profile-control, differential witness, complete operational ARM-P runtime, consciousness, sentience, personhood, life, AGI, or legal/safety/standards/conformity certification is claimed.

## Four components

1. Specification and Protocol — normative architecture, provenance, schema, transaction, threat, and claim-boundary documents.
2. Reference Implementation and Reproduction Kit — bounded Python implementation and reproduction guide.
3. Evidence and Independent Audit Archive — evidence maps, verification guidance, and audit records.
4. Open Verification Release — release navigation, citation, nonclaims, portability, and publication records.

## Reproduction route

git clone https://github.com/Kot141078/cleanroom-arm-p-open-verification.git
cd cleanroom-arm-p-open-verification
git verify-tag v1.0.1
git checkout v1.0.1
py -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -e .
.\.venv\Scripts\python -m pytest
